Hands-on practice

Mode: Training

A virtual SC Edge 2, set up to follow the user manual. Pick a scenario and follow the tasks on the left: each one tells you exactly what to do, and highlights show what to tap next.

Your tasks

Explore mode. No task list and no step-by-step guidance: use the unit, the field kit and the iPad in any order you like.

The unit still behaves as in the manual, so mistakes show up as warnings. Use Reset in Scenario controls to start over.

Instructor: jump to a step

Sets the unit up as if every earlier step were done, so you can test one step without starting over. You can also click any task below.

▶ Video demo

Plays the Preparations scenario by itself, with an on-screen mouse, on a fixed timeline (about 6 min 31 s) that matches the narration script. Start your screen recording first, then press Play.

● Record a demo

Do the scenario yourself while you screen-record with your voice. Every camera move, click, tap and entry is saved with its time, so the demo can replay exactly what you did, with a smoothed camera.

🎙 Talk as you go: your narration is turned into text and saved with the recording (Chrome or Edge; allow the microphone when asked). After a 3-second countdown the scenario starts from the beginning in Guided hands-on mode. Press ■ Stop & save (bottom left) when you finish; the recording is saved as a .json file to send to Claude.

Before you go to the job site: check the kit

Check off the items one by one. Read what each one is for; the matching item glows in the field kit.

    ⏱ 0:00Hints used: 0Score: 100Hidden problem: ?
    1. Office work
    2. Office prep
    3. Install the batteriesTurn to the left side. Loosen the two battery lid screws and lift the lid off. Pick “Batteries” from the field kit and tap the open compartment once for each battery. Refit the lid and tighten both screws.
    4. Switch on and check the battery levelHold the glowing power button for about 4 seconds. The Status LED flashes green while the unit starts. Then read the battery indicator: these batteries have been in storage, so it shows a single flashing red light, meaning the battery is low.
    5. Charge the batteriesTurn to the right side, tap the AC inlet cover to open it, pick “AC adapter” from the field kit and tap the inlet. The battery indicator flashes orange while charging and stops flashing when the batteries are full.
    6. Unplug, close the cover and switch offTap the plug to unplug the AC adapter, then tap the AC inlet cover to close it. Finally hold the power button for about 4 seconds to switch the Edge 2 off, ready to take to the job site.
    7. Field work
    8. Set up and connect
    9. Set up and level the tripodPick “Tripod” from the field kit and choose where to set up: anywhere on site, or over the known point Point A. Over a known point, tap the optical centering device (the eyepiece on the side of the tribrach) to look through it, then shift the tripod until the cross sits on the nail. Then level it: tap a leveling screw, turn the two front screws together in opposite directions to bring the bubble in line with the back screw, then turn the back screw alone until the bubble sits in the circle.
    10. Mount the Edge 2 on the tripodWith the tripod leveled, the Edge 2 glows: tap it to lift it onto the tripod. It screws onto the 5/8 in. thread on the tribrach adapter. (You can also use “Mount Edge 2” in the Actions box.)
    11. Switch on at the tripodWith the unit on the tripod, hold the power button for about 4 seconds (if it’s already on, this checks off by itself). The Status LED flashes green while starting and stays green when ready.
    12. Connect the iPadOpen the iPad and tap Settings, then Wi-Fi. Pick the network that matches the S/N on the white sticker at the rear of the unit, and enter the password.
    13. Open the Edge 2 appUsing Safari in a Private tab is recommended: open Safari, tap the tabs button ⧉, choose Private, then Done. Go Home, open Camera and point it at the QR code on the rear label; tap the yellow scedge.local banner. In Safari, tap Install certificate, then Allow and Close (this only downloads the profile). Install it: Settings → General → VPN & Device Management → AITRIOS_LA_Root_CA_R1 → Install → Install → Install → Done. Trust it: General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → switch on AITRIOS LA Root CA R1 → Continue. Back in the Private Safari tab, tap Launch App.
    14. Create a project with the localization fileInsert the USB memory into the USB 3.0 port behind the right rear cover. In the app, tap Generate a new project, enter a name, tap Local (WGS84 is selected by default) and tap Import Localization File. Pick the file in the USB memory, check the CSV format (meters, NEZ, point, comma), tap OK, then Create.
    15. Set the EdgeBox positionTap PPK Logging, then Add Base Station points. Over Point A: enter its coordinates from the tag beside the marker. Anywhere on site: choose Gnss Positioning and tap Execute Positioning. Then tap Add.
    16. Survey
    17. Log PPK data without warningsRemove the USB memory first: a USB 3.0 device disturbs GNSS reception. Over Point A, enter the pole height you measured with the tape. Tap Start PPK Logging, wait for GNSS to stabilize, fly the drone and power it off, then tap Stop PPK Logging. If an orange warning appears, fix the cause and log again.
    18. Generate a point cloudOpen the left port cover at the rear, pick “SD card” and tap the SD slot. In the app tap Generate Point Cloud, keep “Use PPK only” and tap Next, check the flight data and tap Next, then tap Start PPK processing.
    19. Protect and maintain
    20. Weatherproof the unitWhen rain comes, close both port covers, refit the waterproof USB cap, unplug the AC adapter and close its cover, and keep the battery lid screwed shut.
    21. Hot-swap a batteryIn a dry place with the unit on: loosen the two lid screws, open the lid, pull out one battery and push it back in. Refit the lid and tighten both screws.
    22. Finish
    23. Shut down safelyCheck that no jobs are running, then tap Shut Down in the app or hold the power button for about 4 seconds.

    Survey day complete. Try the knowledge check below, or press Reset to practice again.

    Knowledge check

    Part names, the 4-second power hold, Status LED behavior, charging colors, the Wi-Fi steps, PPK timing, tripod thread and safety rules come from the SC Edge 2 user manual (v12.5.1). The manual doesn’t define every light pattern, so the GNSS, PPK and error light patterns here are placeholders. Times are shortened: the 3-minute GNSS wait, point cloud generation and the 5-hour charge each take seconds.

    Training simulator

    SMART CONSTRUCTION EDGE 2 SIMULATOR

    Practice with the SMART CONSTRUCTION Edge 2 and its iPad app in 3D before going to the job site: prepare the unit and the iPad, run PPK and RTK drone surveys with or without GCPs, set the Edge 2 up as a base station, and process the point cloud. The steps are based on the SC Edge 2 user manual, and mistakes here cost nothing.
